reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles and I don't need another one I'll quit after a week. The lab report and the empty-box guarantee are nice, but nothing here makes me act this week.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule for less per day? And $0.83 a day is not cheap for something I may not finish.
would_change_my_mind: A real flash sale or coupon that gets it near $15 a box, plus a clear reason why bisglycinate alone beats a multi-form blend.
